newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES EASE AFTER 0.25PCT REPO RATE CUT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES EASE AFTER 0.25PCT REPO RATE CUT.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates continued their downward movements started on Friday following the central bank's repo rate cuts, traders said on Monday.
"The market is liquid and there is room for further easing of the overnight rates," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates opened between 23.50 to 24 percent on Monday and finished around 23 percent, compared with Friday's close of 23.75 percent.
Traders said that Friday's repo rate cuts came somewhat earlier than expected but the size was not surprising.
On Friday the NBH cut four of its five repo rates by 0.25 percent each, leaving only the overnight reverse repo unchanged at 17.50 percent
The benchmark one-week reverse repo was cut to 21.50 percent. This is the level where most traders saw overnight rates bottoming out in the second half of this week.
